summary: The empty-completion guard now applies only to completed Responses, and a regression test verifies failed terminals and payloads are preserved.

evidence: The guard in src/provider/openrouter-handlers.ts now checks payload.status === "completed" before converting an answerless response to empty_upstream_completion.
The added openrouter-serving.test.ts case verifies a failed answerless payload returns HTTP 200 unchanged and records response.failed telemetry.
